_doc: The ONE fictional identity of the whole repo (JSA-403). Every test, spec, case file and doc that needs a person's name / e-mail / phone / address uses these values; nothing in the repo may hold the user's own. scripts/fake_identity.py maps a real profile's values onto these (test_all.sh runs the tests on a clone of the data home with this identity swapped in); config/fixtures/f1_student/profile.json carries the same identity.
